policy: One implementation per product surface. A new surface for an existing product extends that product's shared shell (Jovie and Ovie share one shell, canon/PRODUCT.md 'Jovie and Ovie mirror one shell'); it never creates a parallel app, repo, native rewrite or second shell. Every apps/* directory is registered here; a new one needs an explicit kind, and 'independent' needs a justification. Checked by scripts/invariants/one-surface-per-product.mjs (pnpm run surfaces:check).

ovie.shell: apps/web /app/ov on the shared Jovie/Ovie shell
ovie.decision: Tim White 2026-10-28: the native Ovie Mac app shouldn't exist; one Ovie, web, shared shell

apps/web.note: jov.ie; owns the shared Jovie/Ovie shell, including Ovie at /app/ov

apps/ovie.note: Next.js deploy of web Ovie; re-exports Jovie shell routes, owns no screens of its own (docs/OVIE.md)

apps/desktop.note: Electron wrapper loading hosted web; its Ovie door opens /app/ov

apps/ios.justification: Jovie creator iOS and JovieMac product surfaces; no Ovie screens

apps/macos.justification: media-ingest and MenuMonitor operator accessory; tracked for retirement in favor of web Ovie Shipping
